hotels.title: Portugal: Algarve Luxury Retreat on Private Lake with Vilamoura Marina Views & Floating Restaurant
hotels.description: Set on a private lake with views across the Vilamoura marina, Domes Lake Algarve is a five-star retreat where the natural world blends with true luxury. Spend days between the pools and Praia de Falesia - one of Europe's most celebrated beaches, with direct access from the hotel plus dedicated loungers reserved for resort guests. Unwind at Soma Spa, where treatments draw on ancient Greek traditions alongside hammam rituals and wellness experiences. Five world-class golf courses are easily accessible via a complimentary shuttle. Dining is a highlight, spanning six distinct concepts: from Greek and Portuguese fusion at Gustatio and wood-fired Italian at Antonino's, to the lakeside floating experience at Blend Nikkei and Wine. Round off the evening at Migratory Bar, a champagne and cocktail lounge where every drink tells its own story.

hotels.title: Portugal Oceanfront Glamour with Daily Breakfast, Nightly Drinks, Airport Transfers & Ocean Views
hotels.description: Perched on the cliffs of the central Algarve coast, W Algarve brings the brand's signature high-energy playfulness to one of Portugal's most dramatic stretches of coastline, easily accessible with included airport transfers. All rooms come with balconies and ocean vistas, while onsite facilities span a sprawling pool and deck, the lavish AWAY Spa, and six dining venues. Market Kitchen draws on seasonal produce from local farmers, Paper Moon brings refined Italian dining to the clifftop, while Vino pairs over 200 wines with gourmet charcuterie as the sun drops into the sea. When the vibe calls for something more casual, SIP@WET serves ocean-inspired cocktails and healthy bites by the pool. Find your zen at the nearby Evaristo or Balbina Beach or head straight to AWAY Spa for endlessly indulgent treatments. A rooftop relaxation lounge, multisport courts and a fully equipped fitness pavilion keep the active set happy. From the clifftop AIR venue to the rooftop Paper Moon Terrace, everyone will find their slice of bliss here.
